page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred: title block at top, then a woodcut of a tree on a mound, then the motto, imprint and date. Handwritten ownership notes at the foot and a library pencil number at the top are not printed text.

main_text.l: Ecce agnus ille Dei, qui tollit pec-

page.notes: The woodcut shows a tree growing from a mound, with animals at its base; no text. The handwritten inscriptions at the foot ("Pro Joanne Heinrycho Zinggio ... Biblioth. Civ. D.D. J.J. Wagnerus") and the pencilled "5.348" at the top are not printed and are omitted. The woodcut is not transcribed. Hyphens at line ends "HESTE-" and "Ho-" and "pec-" are printed.
